note: Seasonal climate outlook integrated with drought early warning. Escalation rule: if forecast is 'below normal' AND EW status is Watch/Warning, escalate one tier (bounded by Alert).
limitations: Seasonal forecast skill over East Africa is modest (precipitation particularly)
Statistical downscaling assumes forecast bias is stationary
Tercile classification uses fixed thresholds (+/-10%) rather than historical distribution
Escalation rule is heuristic; not validated against historical outcomes
